conventions.frames: frames = number of 30 fps intervals; keys = frames + 1; Blender frame = 1 + clip frame
conventions.loops: loop clips repeat keys 0..N with pose(N) equal to pose(0); Unreal loops over length = frames/30
conventions.root_motion: root bone translation baked in centimetres in Unreal axes (forward +X); in_place clips keep root at the origin
conventions.additive: hit_* are authored as offsets from their first frame; Unreal derives the additive pose from frame 0

layers.upper: upper-body layer from spine_01 upward over the locomotion base
